command:
printf %s '#!/bin/sh
# PROVIDE: tdn_gateway
# REQUIRE: NETWORKING
# KEYWORD: shutdown
. /etc/rc.subr
name=tdn_gateway
rcvar=tdn_gateway_enable
start_cmd=tdn_gateway_start
stop_cmd=tdn_gateway_stop
tdn_gateway_start()
{
 /sbin/kldstat -n ipsec >/dev/null 2>&1 || /sbin/kldload ipsec
 /sbin/sysctl kern.crypto.allow_soft=1
 /sbin/route delete default >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
 /usr/bin/printf '"'"'gateway-start %s\n'"'"' "$(/bin/date -u +%FT%TZ)" >> /var/log/tdn-lifecycle.log
 /usr/sbin/daemon -o /var/log/tdn-charon.log -p /var/run/tdn-charon.pid /usr/local/libexec/ipsec/charon
 n=0
 while test "$n" -lt 20; do
  /usr/local/sbin/swanctl --load-all && return 0
  n=$((n+1))
  /bin/sleep 1
 done
 return 1
}
tdn_gateway_stop()
{
 if test -s /var/run/tdn-charon.pid; then
  /bin/kill "$(cat /var/run/tdn-charon.pid)" || true
 fi
}
load_rc_config "$name"
: "$tdn_gateway_enable"
run_rc_command "$1"
' > /usr/local/etc/rc.d/tdn_gateway; chmod 555 /usr/local/etc/rc.d/tdn_gateway
fsync /etc/rc.conf; fsync /etc/sysctl.conf; fsync /usr/local/etc/rc.d/tdn_gateway; fsync /etc; fsync /usr/local/etc/rc.d; sync; wc -c /etc/rc.conf /usr/local/etc/rc.d/tdn_gateway

command:
printf %s '#!/bin/sh
# PROVIDE: tdn_gateway
# REQUIRE: NETWORKING
# KEYWORD: shutdown
. /etc/rc.subr
name=tdn_gateway
rcvar=tdn_gateway_enable
start_cmd=tdn_gateway_start
stop_cmd=tdn_gateway_stop
tdn_gateway_start()
{
 /sbin/kldstat -n ipsec >/dev/null 2>&1 || /sbin/kldload ipsec
 /sbin/sysctl kern.crypto.allow_soft=1
 /sbin/route delete default >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
 /usr/bin/printf '"'"'gateway-start %s\n'"'"' "$(/bin/date -u +%FT%TZ)" >> /var/log/tdn-lifecycle.log
 /usr/sbin/daemon -o /var/log/tdn-charon.log -p /var/run/tdn-charon.pid /usr/local/libexec/ipsec/charon
 n=0
 while test "$n" -lt 20; do
  /usr/local/sbin/swanctl --load-all && return 0
  n=$((n+1))
  /bin/sleep 1
 done
 return 1
}
tdn_gateway_stop()
{
 if test -s /var/run/tdn-charon.pid; then
  /bin/kill "$(cat /var/run/tdn-charon.pid)" || true
 fi
}
load_rc_config "$name"
: "$tdn_gateway_enable"
run_rc_command "$1"
' > /usr/local/etc/rc.d/tdn_gateway; chmod 555 /usr/local/etc/rc.d/tdn_gateway
fsync /etc/rc.conf; fsync /etc/sysctl.conf; fsync /usr/local/etc/rc.d/tdn_gateway; fsync /etc; fsync /usr/local/etc/rc.d; sync; wc -c /etc/rc.conf /usr/local/etc/rc.d/tdn_gateway
